title: WebGL generative-morphology scaffold
description: Initial project scaffold implementing the stack decisions in CLAUDE.md Structure: TS + Vite, raw WebGL2 + twgl, our own structure/provenance layer, Tweakpane controls. No real plant-morphology generation rules yet — those wait on PRINCIPLES.md's Design principles section. This epic only proves the pipeline end to end with placeholder content.

title: Scaffold Vite + TypeScript project
description: Initialize Vite + TypeScript, a canvas element, npm run dev serving it. No generation or rendering logic yet -- just the shell everything else attaches to.
close_reason: Vite + TypeScript scaffolded, canvas element in index.html, npm run dev verified serving and tsc --noEmit clean. No generation/render logic yet.

title: WebGL2 + twgl smoke test
description: Get a WebGL2 context via twgl.js and prove the render path end to end: compile a minimal shader, draw one thing. twgl is only for removing ceremony (shader/buffer/uniform boilerplate) -- no scene graph, no draw-command abstraction beyond what we write ourselves. See CLAUDE.md Structure section.

title: Structure/provenance data model
description: Define the structure tree TS types (rule id, parameters, seed lineage, children) plus one placeholder pure generation function producing a trivial structure from a seed. This is the provenance layer principle 2 requires, and what workflow principles 5-6 (exposed parameters, inspector, locks) attach to. No WebGL references in this module. Can proceed in parallel with the WebGL smoke test -- only depends on the project scaffold.

title: Wire structure to renderer
description: Renderer consumes the structure tree and draws it via the WebGL2/twgl setup. The renderer must not know about generation rules or parameters beyond the structure's public shape (principle 2).

title: Test runner + first determinism test
description: Pick a test runner (Vitest fits Vite) and write the first test: same seed into the placeholder generator produces the same structure (principle 3). Establishes the testing practice for the project -- pure generation gets unit tests, rendering is verified visually, not automated.

title: Tweakpane control panel
description: Expose the placeholder rule's parameters as Tweakpane sliders. Changing a slider regenerates the structure and re-renders (workflow principle 5). UI code stays isolated from generation/render modules.

title: New-seed button and parameter/macro locks
description: Add a 'new random seed' button and per-parameter/macro lock toggles that override the new seed for locked values (workflow principle 6, the realtime-explorer discussion). Requires macros to be individually addressable per principle 5.
